prompt_rule_definition: target_rtg = the maximum episode return of the training set; rtg_scale = the largest absolute RTG of the training set. Computed from the anchor's OWN 200 episodes and never from P7.2b's calibration artifact, which registers CityFlow-trained subjects

registered_in: PREREGISTRATION A18(a); BRIEF_38 section 3.3; Amendment A3
role: the C3 transfer curve's k = 200 endpoint: a DT trained from scratch on SUMO, on 200 MaxPressure probe episodes over draws 201-400 (PREREGISTRATION A18(a))
what_this_is_not: It is the curve's k = 200 endpoint and the paper says exactly what it is: what target-domain probe data alone buys the same architecture -- NOT an upper bound on achievable SUMO performance, and NOT a target-domain online policy. A18(b) registers why there is no online SUMO anchor (no MAPPO-on-SUMO path, contract C8's metric-set defect, >= 1,000 on-policy episodes per seed); its absence is deferred to P11 and is named as a limitation in the paper's C3 section, not in a footnote.
